info.title: deltd API
info.description: docs/deltd-api-v1.md. Implemented subset: Session (§6.1, sign-in through deltos-identityd, docs/identityd.md), Library (§6.2) and Search (§6.3) groups, /status, progress events (§8), the outline and reader reads of Reading (§6.4) and the Personal group (§6.5, private to the signed-in person, not Guest, Cache-Control: no-store). Every endpoint except sign-in needs identityd's session cookie (delt_session, or __Host-delt_session over HTTPS). Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE needs Origin equal to the WebOS origin and, once signed in, X-Delt-CSRF equal to the session's csrf_token. Pack content is served on pack hostnames, not here (§4).
